extDescription.message: Sends ICU.Live your channel's exact subscriber count as shown in YouTube Studio. Nothing else.

pasteCode.message: Paste the code you generated in the ICU.Live panel, under Shield.

footer.message: It only sends the exact subscriber count shown in YouTube Studio. It never asks for keys or passwords.

openSubs.message: Open the subscriber count in YouTube Studio

pausedMsg.message: Not sending. Tap Send to start sending your subscribers again.

waitingMsg.message: Sending again: waiting for the next update from YouTube Studio (about 10 seconds).

st200invalid.message: sent, but it does not match the public count yet

st403.message: the channel open in YouTube Studio is not the linked one

stOther.message: ICU.Live did not accept it, code $CODE$

nothingYet.message: Nothing sent yet: open the real-time subscriber count in YouTube Studio.

needStudio.message: Open YouTube Studio to use it

linkFail.message: Could not link: the code expired or was already used.

confirmUnlink.message: Unlink the extension? Your channel will stop showing the shield.

tWaiting.message: waiting for the next update from YouTube Studio

tRejected.message: the last send was not accepted

pageLinked.message: Extension linked. Open YouTube Studio so it can send your subscribers.

pageLinkedWith.message: Extension linked to $CHANNEL$. Open YouTube Studio so it can send your subscribers.

pageLinkFail.message: Could not link: the code expired or was already used. Generate a new one in the ICU.Live panel.

pageLinkError.message: Could not link. Try again in a few minutes.
